directives.intuition: Bond rout may pause into Fed minutes (28h) on profit-taking, then resume if minutes show Fed complacency; binary risk high, positioned for continued risk-off but watch for reversal if Fed acknowledges
directives.summary: Bond rout persists (US 30Y 5.31%, 19Y high), geopolitical spike aging (8h no new attacks, tankers cautious but stable), JPY strong (BoJ Sept hike), GBP weak into hot CPI (16h), oil/gold fade on yields
